sectionHeader.heading: From Base Paper XGBoost to Clinical Safe Ensemble
sectionHeader.subhead: How BiSpec-AI advances beyond Zhang et al. (2024) single-model pairwise XGBoost — eliminating target-order leakage, enforcing monotonic toxicity guardrails, and lifting holdout ROC-AUC to 95.06%.

stages.name: Base Paper Foundation
stages.timeline: J. Cancer Res. Clin. Oncol. • GSE131907
stages.description: Foundational single-cell pairwise learning framework integrating 208,506 NSCLC cells with clinical bispecific antibody precedents.
keyMilestones: 198 tumor surface antigens profiled for tumor vs. healthy expression
Symmetric pairwise feature representation for Target A × Target B

stages.name: XGBoost Pairwise Baseline
stages.description: Regularized gradient-boosted trees achieved top ROC-AUC in the base paper, but relied on one unconstrained tree model with no hard safety gating.
keyMilestones: Base paper Fig. 3 champion: 89.29% ROC-AUC (XGBoost + Pairwise AI)
Outperformed GBDT (86.70%), DNN (85.92%), and Random Forest (84.93%)
Gap: No monotonic toxicity constraints or multi-model uncertainty bounds

stages.name: Leakage-Free & Monotonic Safety
stages.description: Deduplicated 771 canonical pairs (0% A–B vs. B–A split leakage) with uniform NSCLC context and mathematically enforced off-tumor safety monotonicity.

stages.name: Clinical Safe Ensemble + RAG
stages.description: Out-of-fold calibrated 4-model consensus combining HistGBDT, XGBoost, GBDT, and ExtraTrees with live uncertainty (±%) and literature synthesis.
keyMilestones: 95.06% holdout ROC-AUC & 95.54% 5-Fold CV (+5.77% over base XGBoost)
90.3% clinical specificity with live toxicity veto & 4-model quorum
Real-time NVIDIA Nemotron + FAISS RAG mechanistic explanation
